test_title: PYST 31: SSC MTS 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Average of 11 numbers is 8. If every number is tripled, then what will be the new average of the numbers?
solution:
**Given:**

The average of 11 numbers = 8

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of value/Total values

**Calculation**

The total sum of all 11 numbers = 11 × 8

⇒ 88

When every number is tripled, then the total sum becomes:

⇒ 88 × 3
